title: Helpdesk & Drilling Systems Monitoring Support
description:
Helpdesk \& Drilling Systems Monitoring Support

**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred  
**Education:** Diploma/Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related field  
**CTC:** ₹4\.2 – ₹5\.4 LPA, depending on experience and technical skills  
**Work Schedule:** 12\-hour rotational shifts  
**Operational Coverage:** 24 hours a day, 7 days a week  
**Shifts:** Day and night shifts, including weekends and public holidays as per roster

About the Role

We are looking for a **Helpdesk \& Drilling Systems Monitoring Support** professional to join our remote operations team.

The role is responsible for providing continuous monitoring support for drilling technology systems and applications. The successful candidate will conduct scheduled system checks, monitor drilling data and system health, identify abnormalities or interruptions, document findings and escalate issues to the appropriate technical or operational team.

This is a **24/7 operational support function**. Employees will work assigned **12\-hour day or night shifts** according to the roster.

The role requires a person who is reliable, technically capable, highly attentive to detail and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Drilling Systems Monitoring

* Monitor the **Driller's HMI** throughout the assigned shift.
* Confirm that the Driller's HMI is online and operating correctly.
* Monitor and record the current rig activity.
* Verify current **bit depth** and **well/hole depth**.
* Confirm that the Driller's HMI time matches the applicable local time.
* Monitor **hard disk space and system utilisation**.
* Identify any abnormal system behaviour or interruptions.

2\. Web Application Monitoring

* Monitor the drilling Web Application.
* Verify that **bit depth matches the Driller's HMI**.
* Verify that **hole depth matches the Driller's HMI**.
* Confirm that rig data is updating correctly on the **time plot**.
* Confirm that MWD data is updating correctly on the **time plot**.
* Confirm that rig data is updating correctly on the **depth plot**.
* Confirm that MWD data is updating correctly on the **depth plot**.
* Check for any new gaps or interruptions in the depth plots since the previous review.
* Record and report any discrepancies identified.

3\. Infrastructure \& System Health Monitoring

Monitor the following systems and confirm that they remain operational:

**Portainer**

* Confirm that all containers are running and healthy.

**Grafana**

* Confirm that the system status is healthy/green.

**Rig Nodes**

* Confirm that all rig nodes are connected.

**Additional Rig Computers**

* Confirm that the Directional PC is online and running.
* Confirm that the EDR Admin Computer is online and operational.

4\. Scheduled Monitoring \& Reporting

* Perform scheduled system reviews **every 3 hours** during the assigned shift.
* Complete the prescribed monitoring checklist accurately.
* Record system status, observations and any abnormalities identified during each review.
* Ensure monitoring reports are completed and submitted within the required timeframe.
* Maintain accurate records of issues and actions taken.
* Identify trends or recurring issues and highlight them to the relevant team.

5\. Issue Identification \& Escalation

* Identify system outages, connectivity issues, data discrepancies, missing data or abnormal system behaviour.
* Carry out basic troubleshooting within the scope of the role.
* Escalate technical issues promptly according to established escalation procedures.
* Provide the technical team with clear and accurate information when escalating an issue.
* Record the time of the issue, affected system, observations and actions taken.
* Continue monitoring affected systems as required until the issue is resolved or handed over.
* Ensure unresolved issues are clearly communicated during shift handover.

6\. Shift Handover

* Provide a clear handover to the incoming shift.
* Communicate all outstanding issues, system abnormalities and follow\-up actions.
* Ensure monitoring records are complete and up to date before completing the shift.
* Highlight any recurring or critical issues requiring continued attention.

Education

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics \& Communication, Information Systems, Engineering or a related technical discipline**.
* Candidates with relevant technical support, NOC or system monitoring experience and an appropriate technical qualification may also be considered.

Experience

* **1–3 years of experience** in one or more of the following:
* IT Helpdesk
* Technical Support
* NOC Operations
* System Monitoring
* IT Operations
* Application Monitoring
* Remote Technical Support
* Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in a **24/7 operational environment** will be an advantage.

Technical Skills

The candidate should have a good understanding of:

* Computer systems and applications
* Basic networking and connectivity
* System and application monitoring
* Basic troubleshooting
* Data monitoring and validation
* Incident identification and escalation
* Remote support tools

Desirable Technical Experience

Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* **Grafana**
* **Portainer**
* **Docker / Containers**
* **Linux**
* Network monitoring
* NOC monitoring tools
* EDR / endpoint management
* Remote desktop/support tools
* Oil \& Gas technology
* Drilling technology
* Directional drilling systems
* MWD data
* Drilling data or rig monitoring systems

Key Skills \& CompetenciesAttention to Detail

Ability to identify discrepancies between systems and recognise when data or system behaviour does not appear normal.

Monitoring Discipline

Ability to consistently complete scheduled checks and reports at the required **3\-hour intervals** throughout the shift.

Troubleshooting

Ability to investigate basic technical issues and determine when an issue requires escalation.

Communication

Ability to clearly communicate technical observations, issues and required actions to the relevant team.

Documentation

Ability to maintain accurate monitoring records and provide clear shift handovers.

Reliability

Strong commitment to assigned shifts and scheduled monitoring activities.

Independent Working

Ability to work effectively with limited direct supervision in a remote environment.

Shift \& Roster Requirements

This role supports a **24\-hour, 7\-day operational environment**.

Employees will work **12\-hour rostered shifts** and may be assigned:

* Day shifts
* Night shifts
* Weekend shifts
* Public holiday shifts

Employees are expected to work according to the assigned roster and remain available and attentive throughout their scheduled shift.

The successful candidate must be comfortable with **rotational day and night shifts**.

Remote Work Requirements

As this is a fully remote position, candidates must have:

* Reliable high\-speed internet connectivity.
* A suitable and quiet workspace.
* A reliable computer/laptop suitable for remote monitoring activities.
* Ability to maintain connectivity and availability throughout the assigned shift.
* Ability to work independently from home.
* A suitable backup arrangement for internet/power interruptions where reasonably possible.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely completion of scheduled 3\-hourly monitoring checks.
* Accuracy and completeness of monitoring reports.
* Prompt identification of system abnormalities.
* Timely escalation of technical issues.
* Accurate documentation of incidents and observations.
* Effective shift handovers.
* Consistent adherence to monitoring and escalation procedures.
* Reliable attendance and adherence to the assigned roster.

Remuneration

**₹4\.2 – ₹5\.4 LPA CTC**

The final remuneration will depend on the candidate's relevant experience, technical skills and overall suitability for the role.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to work in a **technology\-driven drilling environment** supporting systems that are used in real\-time drilling operations.

The role provides exposure to:

* Drilling technology
* Real\-time data monitoring
* Remote operations
* System and application monitoring
* Technical troubleshooting
* Data validation
* Modern monitoring platforms and infrastructure

If you are technically curious, detail\-oriented and enjoy monitoring systems and solving technical issues, we would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work in night shifts also?

description:

*Location:* ***Vennala, Kochi, Kerala (Onsite)***

About Invigilate

Invigilate® is a technology\-driven assessment and examination solutions provider affiliated with NCVET, Government of India. We support educational institutions, government organizations, training partners, and enterprises in conducting secure, scalable, and technology\-enabled assessments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and responsible Operations Executive (Technical and Support) for the smooth execution of technology\-enabled assessment operations. The role involves coordinating day\-to\-day operational and technical activities, supporting assessment platforms and users, monitoring issues, maintaining records, and ensuring that assigned activities are completed accurately and within timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Support day\-to\-day IT and assessment operations and ensure smooth execution of assigned activities.

· Assist with assessment platform operations, including batch creation, candidate data uploads, configuration checks, and basic troubleshooting.

· Monitor assessment sessions and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve technical or operational issues promptly.

· Identify, document, and escalate platform errors, technical issues, and operational discrepancies.

· Maintain accurate trackers, operational records, issue logs, and supporting documentation.

· Perform data entry, data verification, and basic quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.

· Prepare and maintain operational reports using Microsoft Excel and other office tools.

· Create and support presentations, reports, and operational documentation using PowerPoint and Word.

· Follow defined SOPs, quality standards, data\-security practices, and organizational policies.

· Support new processes, tools, and technology implementations as required.

· Take ownership of assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and provide timely status updates to reporting managers.

· Carry out other operational and IT\-support activities assigned by the management.

Required Skills \& Competencies

· Strong verbal and written communication skills – mandatory.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

· Basic technical troubleshooting and IT skills.

· Good presentation and documentation skills.

· Proactive approach with strong ownership and accountability.

· Ability to identify issues, follow through, and coordinate for resolution.

· Willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, and processes.

· Good attention to detail and ability to work accurately under deadlines.

· Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team.

Preferred Qualifications

· 1–2 years of experience in IT operations, assessment operations, technical support, or a related role is preferred.

· Freshers with strong communication, technical aptitude, and willingness to learn are welcome.

· Experience with assessment/examination platforms or operational coordination will be an added advantage.

title: Senior IT Support
description:
Position: Senior IT Support  
Location: Kochi,India / Sharjah, UAE (supporting UAE \& India offices)  
Reports to: Management

Role Overview

The Senior IT Support will be responsible for managing and securing the company’s IT infrastructure across all offices. This includes server administration, network and security management, user support, license compliance, data privacy, and IT policy implementation. The role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and vendor coordination to ensure smooth operations, security, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure \& Server Management

* Manage Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policies.
* Oversee file servers, QNAP devices, backups, and storage integration.
* Ensure uptime, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Plan and implement system upgrades and patches.

Network \& Security

* Administer Fortinet firewalls, VPNs (FortiClient), and secure tunneling across offices.
* Monitor network health, connectivity, and performance.
* Define and enforce security policies (USB restrictions, file permissions, password policies).
* Manage endpoint protection, antivirus, and monitoring tools.

User \& Application Support

* Provide IT support to 60\+ users across UAE and India.
* Manage software deployment and license compliance (Microsoft 365, AutoCAD, ARES Commander, Bentley, etc.).
* Ensure seamless SSO / credential integration across systems.
* Maintain user access controls and prevent unauthorized data sharing.

Data Privacy \& Compliance

* Implement IT policies aligned with data protection and confidentiality standards.
* Monitor and audit IT activities for compliance.
* Support ISO\-related IT documentation (policies, SOPs, forms).

Monitoring \& Reporting

* Use IT monitoring tools for system, network, and hardware health checks.
* Maintain logs of IT activities, incidents, and preventive actions.
* Provide regular IT performance and security reports to management.

Vendor \& Project Management

* Coordinate with IT vendors for hardware, software, and service contracts.
* Lead IT projects (server upgrades, AD migration, cloud integration, etc.).
* Evaluate and recommend new technologies for cost\-effective adoption.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Windows Server 2025 \& Active Directory
* Group Policy Management
* Microsoft 365 / Azure AD
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Fortinet firewalls)
* NAS/Storage systems (QNAP)
* Experience in server virtualization, backup solutions, and endpoint management.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks, ISO standards, and data protection practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to lead IT initiatives independently and train junior staff.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**General Responsibilities:**
